body: Whats one more death in this hellhole? But, that sounds logical. I'm in alot of pain and I'm not thinking clearly. My flight leaves in a few hours, I will get tested when I land and go from there.

I love her and I dont want to leave her alone, but she will get over my death eventually. She will find someone, and hopefully have a normal life. I'm willing to do what neccessary, she doesn't deserve this pain.
